lineage.core_design: signal relay duties, diversion locations, and interrupted relay completion

chapters.title: Calibration-token convention
chapters.body: A calibration token is stamped by the relay location where its bearer performs the calibration.

chapters.title: Teren token stamp
chapters.body: Teren Lox's fog-day calibration token is stamped Lacquer Tunnel.

chapters.title: Delivery completion definition
chapters.body: An eastward relay delivery counts complete only when its receipt lens remains clear through the final echo.

chapters.title: Hail lens log
chapters.body: The hail log records that the Orchid relay's receipt lens clouded before the final echo.

chapters.title: Lens cloth
chapters.body: Siva Rehn keeps the relay lens wrapped in a blue linen cloth.

chapters.title: Chime pattern
chapters.body: A cleared tunnel is marked by one long chime followed by two short chimes.

chapters.title: Unknown platform visitor
chapters.body: The visitor sheet records a boot print at Orchid Platform but names no visitor and gives no time.

chapters.title: Open relay audit
chapters.body: The audit confirms the shutter was inspected but does not record whether its final alignment passed.
